limitations: Source audit only. No actual frame or application execution proves visual or functional parity.
All findings require recorded disposition; deleting the old replay filename is not acceptance.

findings.problem: Exact 80x24, TrueColor, accent RGB(0x48,0xe0,0x54), CapsuleMulti, paused-motion and menu-position selectors remain. The new painter takes no live model or state and supplies 19 fixed positioned rows containing pre-clipped transcript, pane-border and scrollbar cells. This is reference-screen reproduction, partly relocated to Termrock.
findings.required_fix: Replace with live pane data and shared workspace/layout components; remove selector and procedural row plate in the same verified series.

findings.problem: The real ContextMenu draws and owns input, then a second painter overwrites it. Visible Change title selection is permanently true and does not consume MenuState, hover or pressed state. The painter has no IDs, measurement, input or typed actions.
findings.required_fix: Use only ContextMenu with live title/items/state; fix its shared layout/theme contracts rather than overwrite its cells.

findings.problem: New calls to set_undrawn_top_bar_cursor register an undrawn full-area focusable keyboard editor with EDITING on the top layer and force fixed cursor positions. The runtime API predates this increment, but these uses are new.
findings.required_fix: Remove these registrations. Preserve the reference cursor behavior through an explicit overlay cursor policy and a real rendered control owner.

findings.problem: The custom put loop splits Unicode scalar values and skips zero-width characters. A combining accent in e plus U+0301 is discarded.
findings.required_fix: Use the shared grapheme-aware text renderer and test wide and combining labels.

findings.problem: The public API bundles an entire Jackin-like screen, accepts raw positioned cell spans, uses a fixed 29-column menu and 11-column bold tail, and paints an attachment at fixed column24 with literal RGB inks. This does not implement shared menu or responsive workspace ownership.
findings.required_fix: Keep generic menu, tabs, workspace, status and hint contracts separate; use documented measured layout policies and semantic component theme configuration.

reference_contract: Frozen src/bin/jackin_preview/screens/capsule.rs:360-381 derives title from the daemon tab and anchors ContextMenu to the real tab area.
Frozen capsule.rs:1466-1488 derives tab labels and status from daemon data; 1897-1911 dispatches shared menu actions.
That source file is byte-identical between the fixed baseline and fixed design revisions.
replacement_plan: Derive menu data from the live selected tab and use the existing ContextMenu state/update/measure/draw contract.
Remove both menu repaint calls, exact viewport/theme/scenario selectors, and undrawn editor registrations.
Retain live pane rendering under the overlay; delete the specialized view and feedback painter after consumers are removed.
Prove real keyboard movement, pointer hover/press/release, dismissal, focus restoration, cursor, changed labels, Unicode and adjacent sizes; then run frozen CLI paired comparisons.
record_correction: The migration matrix description that this screen now uses live tabs/entries is unsupported by this source. Keep the replacement unresolved.
